bias.en: Uptrend · pulling back from a record
bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 从纪录高点回调

read.en: TSMC's ADR set a record $487.47 on Oct 5 and has fallen 7% since. The rising 30-day ($442) and 100-day ($429) averages keep the trend positive. Short-term signals turned in the last two sessions: price is below the 5 and 10-day averages, MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 9, Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Oct 8, and RSI cooled from 76 to 52.
read.zh: 台积电 ADR 于 10月5日创下 $487.47 纪录，此后回落 7%。上行中的 30 日（$442）与 100 日（$429）均线令趋势保持正面。短线信号在最近两个交易日转弱：股价跌破 5 日和 10 日均线，MACD 于 10月9日下穿信号线，抛物线 SAR 于 10月8日转空，RSI 由 76 降至 52。

read.en: Price is sitting on first support at $450 (the Oct 9 low and a June pivot). Below it, $440–442 (the 30-day average and a September pivot) is the stronger level, then $423, which was tested five times. Overhead, $465–470 (the short averages) and $477–481 (June highs) stand before the record.
read.zh: 股价正处于首个支撑 $450（10月9日低点与6月转折点）。其下 $440–442（30 日均线与9月转折点）支撑更强，再下为五次测试的 $423。上方依次为 $465–470（短期均线）与 $477–481（6月高点），然后是纪录高点。
